prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

a warm bronze-brown complexion, late 30s goddess, powerlifter physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — an enormous, overwhelmingly powerful woman; colossal thick trapezius muscle rising high around her neck, massive round boulder shoulders, enormous thick arms with dense hard muscle, a broad powerful back, a deeply carved abdomen, colossal glutes and hips extending far beyond the shoulders, gigantic quadriceps with a deep sweep; her head looks small on top of her massive frame; not slim, not a fitness body, powerful and heavy at once; her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other, half-up half-down natural black hair — her bare skin covered from the neck down in a photogram darkroom print: crisp white silhouettes of feathers, keys, leaves, glass beads and lace laid across a deep black ground over her torso, arms and legs, soft grey halos and translucent overlaps where the objects were layered, fine silvery photographic grain, the print sitting on living skin and following every curve beneath it, covering all of her skin from the neck to the ankles and the backs of her hands, her face left unpainted and the pattern fading out at the neck. Her face, ears, neck and hands are real living skin with visible pores and fine grain, fine peach-fuzz hairs, a soft natural flush. Pose: hands pressed together raised above her head in a devotional pose, eyes lifted — most extreme powerlifter silhouette ever displayed.
Footwear: heels of the most absurdly extreme height imaginable, strappy platform stiletto sandals made of polished jet-black leather, each with a razor-thin tapered heel taller than her entire shin from ankle to knee and a towering hidden front platform, her feet arched fully vertical on the very tips of her toes like a dancer on pointe, her legs stretched impossibly long and her whole body lifted far above the ground on them as if standing on stilts.
Nails: the longest nails physically imaginable, almond nails each a full hand-length past her fingertips, in glossy jet-black polish.
Jewelry: sculpted gold armbands high on both upper arms, a pearl choker and a long strand of pearls hanging low on her chest, and thick polished gold bangles stacked on both wrists. Jewelry is metal and pearl only, worn on the body, nothing added to her face or ears.
Face: her face is bare of any garment — real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Polynesian woman with a broad face, full lips and large dark eyes, an unmistakably feminine face with a calm, composed expression, makeup: extremely heavy, fully saturated and bold, never subtle, faded or blended away: sharply angled thin brows, a razor-sharp winged cat-eye liner extending far past the outer corner, deep brown-black eyeshadow, long lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, strongly sculpted contour, a deep wine-red matte lip.

Background: a bright sun-dappled forest path with a packed earth floor, a waist-high wooden rail, a standard bench and tall straight trees, under a soft overcast sky with gentle diffused light, lit by natural light with soft shadows on the skin, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus. ONE woman only. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at waist height, the whole figure from the soles of the boots to the top of her head completely visible, with the door, railing or steps beside her at normal human scale so the extreme heel height reads at a glance, the towering heels clearly separating the boot soles from the floor. This is one single photograph taken with one camera at one moment, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/5.6, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph. Portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
